messages:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] migration 'user_notifications_add_index' started on prod-canary. Status=running. Backfill processed=1.2M/3.5M rows. Observed lock wait on users (pid=34211). Tagging #eng-releases :warning:
Kate: @deploy-bot thanks — can someone confirm if this is holding writes or just long read locks?
Samir: seeing elevated write latencies on api-prod (p95 220ms -> 720ms). Any DDL lock info?
oncall-bot: alert: db.users table average lock_wait = 4800ms over last 2m. Connections queue approaching 95%.
Maria: if writes are impacted we should consider a holdpoint. Can we pause the backfill and let the ALTER finish?
Samir: backfill is the long part; ALTER completed earlier. The online backfill is doing index population. It's what's holding checkpoints.
Ryan: what's the change window? I thought this was scheduled for 02:00-04:00 UTC tomorrow, not now. How did this start during peak?
Kate: it was kicked via canary pipeline by a hotfix branch — mis-scheduled. We're going to need rollback options.
Samir: options: 1) stop backfill (if supported) and resume in maintenance window; 2) force-rollback the migration apply; 3) let it finish and risk P95 spikes.
Maria: do we have a stop/resume mechanism for the index backfill? I think our backfiller supports a graceful pause with checkpointing.
Samir: we can send SIGTERM to the backfill worker to checkpoint. I'll prepare the command.
Samir: running: ```kubectl exec -it backfill-idx-2 -- pkill -SIGINT backfill-worker && sleep 15 && kubectl logs backfill-idx-2 | tail -n 40```
Samir: observed checkpoint: "progress: 1.2M rows, checkpoint id=2026-03-21T18:22Z" — confirms graceful stop possible.
Kate: good. Decision time. We should avoid impacting customers. Propose: PAUSE backfill now, pin deploy version to previous release (v3.4.1), open rollback ticket for the migration apply, and schedule re-run in tomorrow's window with canary flag.
Ryan: +1. I'll update release notes and the rollback plan. Release notes: "migration attempted outside window, backfill paused, re-run scheduled 02:00-04:00 UTC. No data loss expected."
Maria: add to checklist: ensure backfiller resume uses same checkpoint ID, verify index consistency post-resume, run small canary on 5% traffic first.
Samir: running pause command now.
samir: pause command output: "stopping worker, checkpoint written: s3://backfill-checkpoints/user_notifications_add_index/2026-03-21T18-22Z"
Kate: OK — next steps: 1) pin traffic & pin api image to v3.4.1 in prod (deploybot please), 2) create rollback ticket JIRA-3427 assigned to Samir (include rollback/sql script), 3) schedule reattempt in maintenance window, 4) add note in #release-notes and the weekly changelog.
deploy-bot: Scheduling pin: `/deploy pin service=api version=v3.4.1 env=prod trigger=manual #1768005000` — pinned.
Ryan: created JIRA-3427: "rollback user_notifications_add_index apply" with rollback SQL and postmortem checklist. Assigning to @Samir.
Maria: I'll own the re-run checklist + canary. Putting guardrails: fail-open if progress stalls >30min, and auto-abort after 2h with roll-forward plan.
Kate: thanks team. Quick postmortem note: mis-scheduled canary deployment — we'll add a pre-deploy window check to prevent non-windowed migrations.
Samir: thumbs up. Marking this thread resolved once rollback ticket has PR and deploy pin confirmed. :thumbsup:
Kate: resolving for now — ping me if anything changes.
